title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Archway USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns Noble's full USDC escrow for Archway (33,621.448005 USDC, Noble channel-12) to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG over channel-29 (MsgReturnToNoble with that explicit amount), covering all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/43897B9739BD63E3A08A88191999C632E052724AB96BD4C74AE31375C991F48D) still in circulation on Archway. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
